title: 14-BCV-001 - Construction site fire safety plans
jurisdiction: Alberta (province-wide, as stated by the STANDATA)
code_edition: Alberta Building Code 2014 and Alberta Fire Code 2014

facts.text: Joint fire/building STANDATA 14-BCV-001 addresses authority to accept fire safety plans for construction and demolition sites where fire safety officers or fire department staff are not readily available.

It states that a building safety codes officer exercising powers under their designation and terms of employment may accept the plan under ABC Article 8.1.1.1 and AFC Section 5.6; it names eligible employing bodies and states province-wide scope.

limitations: This is a provincial regulator-issued STANDATA/standing variance, not an individual application, applicant statement, project drawing, permit record or site-specific decision.
The records address the Alberta Building Code 2014 and, where noted, Alberta Fire Code 2014; do not treat them as proof of applicability under the Alberta 2023 code edition or current law.
